title: Coast Guard rescues 2 stranded hikers from coastal cliff in Manzanita, OR
credit: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Michael Clark
description: A Coast Guard Sector Columbia River aircrew rescues two hikers from a coastal cliff near Neahkahnie Beach, OR, Monday, April 25. The hikers became stranded by rising tides after venturing down to their stranded position from a higher vantage point. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Michael Clark)
